import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 15;
    static int[][][][] pathDist = new int[MAX][MAX][MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] edgeCap = new int[400][400];
    static char[][] bioGrid = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] reactMap = new char[20][20];
    static int[] dirX = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dirY = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int iterStep = 3;
    static int[] visitStatus = new int[400];

    static int gridSize, maxTime;

    static int DFS(int cur, int dst, int bottleneck) {
        if (cur == dst) return bottleneck;
        if (visitStatus[cur] == iterStep) return 0;
        visitStatus[cur] = iterStep;
        for (int next = 0; next <= dst; ++next) {
            int pushed = 0;
            if (edgeCap[cur][next] > 0 && (pushed = DFS(next, dst, Math.min(bottleneck, edgeCap[cur][next]))) > 0) {
                edgeCap[cur][next] -= pushed;
                edgeCap[next][cur] += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int getIdx(int r, int c) {
        return (r - 1) * gridSize + (c - 1);
    }

    static int[][] spreadGrid = new int[13][13];
    static int[][] tempSpread = new int[13][13];

    static void spread(int mark) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(spreadGrid[i], 0, tempSpread[i], 0, 13);
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= gridSize; ++r) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= gridSize; ++c) {
                if (tempSpread[r][c] == mark) {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int nr = r + dirX[d];
                        int nc = c + dirY[d];
                        if (nr > 0 && nc > 0 && nr <= gridSize && nc <= gridSize && spreadGrid[nr][nc] < mark && bioGrid[nr][nc] != 'Y') {
                            spreadGrid[nr][nc] = mark;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean pathExists(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int infx, int infy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(spreadGrid[i], 0);
        }
        spreadGrid[sx][sy] = 1;
        spreadGrid[infx][infy] = 2;
        for (int step = 0; step < 100; ++step) {
            spread(1);
            if (spreadGrid[tx][ty] == 1) return true;
            spread(2);
            if (spreadGrid[tx][ty] == 2) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int infx = -1, infy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < MAX; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < MAX; l++) {
                        pathDist[i][j][k][l] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        gridSize = sc.nextInt();
        maxTime = sc.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                bioGrid[i][j + 1] = line.charAt(j);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= gridSize; ++j) {
                pathDist[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                if (bioGrid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    infx = i;
                    infy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                reactMap[i][j + 1] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= gridSize; ++j) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int ni = i + dirX[d];
                    int nj = j + dirY[d];
                    if (ni >= 1 && nj >= 1 && ni <= gridSize && nj <= gridSize) {
                        if (bioGrid[i][j] != 'Y' && bioGrid[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            pathDist[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int k = 1; k <= gridSize; ++k) {
            for (int l = 1; l <= gridSize; ++l) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; ++i) {
                    for (int j = 1; j <= gridSize; ++j) {
                        for (int u = 1; u <= gridSize; ++u) {
                            for (int v = 1; v <= gridSize; ++v) {
                                pathDist[i][j][u][v] = Math.min(pathDist[i][j][u][v], pathDist[i][j][k][l] + pathDist[k][l][u][v]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int sourceNode = gridSize * gridSize * 2 + 1;
        int sinkNode = gridSize * gridSize * 2 + 2;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= gridSize; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(bioGrid[i][j])) {
                    edgeCap[sourceNode][getIdx(i, j)] = bioGrid[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(reactMap[i][j])) {
                    edgeCap[gridSize * gridSize + getIdx(i, j)][sinkNode] = reactMap[i][j] - '0';
                }
                
                if (Character.isDigit(bioGrid[i][j])) {
                    for (int u = 1; u <= gridSize; ++u) {
                        for (int v = 1; v <= gridSize; ++v) {
                            if (bioGrid[i][j] > '0' && reactMap[u][v] > '0') {
                                if (Character.isDigit(reactMap[u][v]) && pathDist[i][j][u][v] <= maxTime && pathExists(i, j, u, v, infx, infy)) {
                                    edgeCap[getIdx(i, j)][gridSize * gridSize + getIdx(u, v)] = 1000;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int flowTotal = 0;
        int augmentFlow;
        while ((augmentFlow = DFS(sourceNode, sinkNode, 1000)) > 0) {
            flowTotal += augmentFlow;
            ++iterStep;
        }
        
        System.out.println(flowTotal);
    }
}
